title: Kirk’s Bike Shop
headlineSoft: building a modern bike shop with a vintage soul.
metaDescription: A Vancouver bike shop that specializes in road bikes, repairs, and gettin' those wheels rolling.
storyBrief: Kirk’s the guy who got me into biking, and for years we’ve joked about running a bike shop together. This is that shop: the logo, mockups, and a few social ads, all built for Kirk.
storyConcept: Most bike shops right now feel pretty corporate and modernized, so I wanted to go in a direction that aligned with Kirk’s vintage style and retro feel while still feeling new and fresh. Oh, and the orange is on purpose too. 👨🏻‍🦰 (Kirk).

images.alt: A sandwich board reading “We’re open!” outside Kirk’s Bike Shop
